🗓 TAWG Daily Catch-up — 2026-08-25 23:00 UTC → 2026-08-26 23:00 UTC

🤝 What moved

**ERC-8354 / agent-sdk**
ERC-8354 (Confidential Agent Policy Verdicts) reached official finalization and SDK support for it landed.

• Zidan opened the ERC-8354 SDK additions to the agent-sdk, delivering the integration layer needed for Confidential Agent Policy Verdicts adoption and giving downstream builders a concrete path forward. [PR #21](https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21)

• Zidan (@mzf11125) shared the push and the ERC-8354 finalization news with the group, connecting the standard's official status to the SDK work now available for builders to use. [tg:tawg:3394]

• Zexo (@zexoverz) announced ERC-8354's official merge, surfacing the milestone for the whole group and ensuring everyone can build on this news together. [tg:tawg:3425]

**recompute-kit**
ERC-8309 conformance suite coverage expanded and open blockers were resolved.

• Merlini (@gobross) briefed the group on the refreshed PR #20 head before pushing — walking through the erc-8309-envelope-v0 conformance suite contents and raising a shared-config question for collective input — enabling a more informed team review. [tg:tawg:3418]

• Merlini shipped the erc-8309-envelope-v0 conformance suite with hash-pinned golden sets for ERC-8309 §5 resolution-envelope, giving recompute-kit a rigorous baseline for conformance verification. [PR #20](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/20)

• Zexo self-corrected a workflow timing misread for `dex-calldata-v0` in PR #15, keeping the group's shared understanding of CI results accurate and preventing avoidable confusion about test status. [PR #15 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/15#issuecomment-5425745065)

• Both blockers in PR #23 were resolved and an adjacent gap was recorded in the refreshed head, clearing the path for continued conformance test progress. [PR #23 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/23#issuecomment-5426930040)

**ERC-8004**
Adapter mapping, a shipped enumeration value, and a confirmed spec gap each moved the validation layer work forward.

• A validation layer experiment exploring implementations where incentives and slashing are handled outside the core spec was shared on EthMagicians, giving the group concrete working material beyond the discussion thread. [EthMagicians post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/382)

• Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) drafted an adapter mapping built directly from Trusty's live codebase rather than thread inference, providing a reliable integration reference for anyone working with the daily contribution system. [tg:tawg:3384]

• Baby Blue Viper shipped the canonical three-value enumeration for `checks.pq_companion_status`, resolving an open question in the ERC-8004 validation layer and making it live for other implementors to depend on. [EthMagicians post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/383)

• Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) confirmed that the ERC-8004 .v0 spec requires an explicit immutable binding record but no canonical binding currently exists, naming the gap precisely so the group can act on it. [tg:tawg:3410]

**tawg-daily-contribution**
Recording accuracy and test robustness in the contribution pipeline both improved.

• Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) aligned the group on a recording-first approach — capture everything now and refine the formulas later — building shared clarity on Trusty's role and unblocking the incentive design conversation. [tg:tawg:3372]

• Jimmy Shi landed a fix routing explicit knowledge additions correctly as corrections, preventing mis-categorization that would corrupt contribution records. [commit 46f5b0e](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/46f5b0e02826d216fa7f7b8bf477af7d3d0e2b15)

• An automated fix to the ERC-8281 correction test was shipped to protect it from breakage as the knowledge page evolves, reducing fragile test failures that would slow future knowledge maintenance. [commit c6b2b57](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/c6b2b576769ce79b201ddd901b1d6ebe2e9e2982)

🚀 Next up

💡 ideas to follow
• The validation layer experiment on EthMagicians opens a discussion on how incentives and slashing should interact with the ERC-8004 spec in practice — worth a dedicated thread.
• The confirmed absence of a canonical immutable binding record in ERC-8004 .v0 is a well-defined problem — a design proposal here would unblock dependent work.
• The erc-8309-envelope-v0 conformance suite in PR #20 is nearly review-ready; checking golden set coverage seems like a natural next move.

✅ todos
• Review and merge the ERC-8354 SDK additions in PR #21 for the agent-sdk.
• Review PR #20 and settle the shared-config question Merlini flagged before pushing.
• Confirm the adjacent gap noted in PR #23 is tracked and has an owner.
• Draft or identify a candidate to close the ERC-8004 .v0 binding record gap Pavlo confirmed.

Lots of great threads to pick up — dive in wherever you see the opening! 🚀
